target.title: Require explicit Keychain interaction for Chromium cookies
target.body:
## Summary

- preserve the released interactive-recovery behavior by default
- provide an explicit host-scoped `withUserInteractionDisallowed` policy for background/no-prompt imports
- retain the host pre-alert immediately before the sole interactive lookup
- stop after one cancelled or failed interactive lookup, rather than advancing to another Safe Storage label
- add injected-lookup regression tests for default recovery, no-UI suppression, and the one-shot boundary

## Root cause

The importer first issued a no-UI `kSecReturnData` lookup, but after `errSecInteractionNotAllowed` it always retried with interaction allowed. A host could therefore intend a background/no-prompt import while the dependency still initiated a Keychain prompt. In addition, a cancelled interactive attempt could advance to another candidate label and prompt again.

## Impact

Existing hosts retain interactive recovery. Hosts performing background work can explicitly suppress interaction around one import via `BrowserCookieKeychainAccessGate.withUserInteractionDisallowed`; that import then fails cleanly if macOS requires UI. Any allowed interactive import performs at most one interactive Keychain lookup.

## Validation

- injected password lookup regressions cover the compatibility default, explicit no-UI policy, and a multi-label cancellation boundary
- the focused local test rerun was blocked in this environment by SwiftPM's unrelated DocC-plugin checkout status operation before test execution; GitHub Actions remains the authoritative compile/test run for this update
- all added tests use injected password lookup closures; no real Keychain item is queried

## Runtime evidence still required

Before merge, a maintainer or explicitly authorized test account should provide redacted macOS evidence for: (1) a no-UI scoped background import returning without a Keychain prompt, and (2) a default interactive import showing the host pre-alert followed by one successful or cancelled Keychain interaction. This PR does not claim to have run live Keychain reads.

Related: steipete/CodexBar#2213, steipete/CodexBar#2214
